name: Chillwind Camp
summary: At the southern pass, Chillwind Camp holds the Alliance line against the Scourge. Alliance soldiers and the Argent Dawn strike nearby strongholds and plague cauldrons from this outpost, before the blighted ruins of Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Edge of the Blight
sections.body:
Chillwind Camp guards the pass from Chillwind Point into the Western Plaguelands. It is the Alliance's first line of defense and its main base for pressing into the region. High mountain ridges keep the worst corruption at a distance, though the north's dead chill hangs over the tents and palisades.

Commander Ashlam Valorfist leads a small garrison of soldiers, scouts, and Argent Dawn specialists. They contain horrors along the King's Road and gather intelligence to reclaim Lordaeron's fallen fields.

sections.title: A War of Attrition
sections.body: Without armies to assault Andorhal or Scholomance, Chillwind Camp depends on independent champions and mercenaries. Its forces strike the Cult of the Damned, disable plague cauldrons poisoning the soil, and keep supply routes open to eastern outposts such as Light's Hope Chapel. Scourge-held ruins lie just north, while the Forsaken fortify the western border. The defenders fight to keep the pass from being overwhelmed.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Chillwind Camp?
faq.answer: Chillwind Camp is the Alliance and Argent Dawn's southern foothold on the Western Plaguelands' border. It is a secure base for attacks against the Scourge in Andorhal and efforts to disable the region's plague cauldrons.

faq.q: How do you reach Chillwind Camp from Southshore?
aliases: how to get to chillwind camp
faq.answer: From Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills, head north toward Tarren Mill, then follow the mountain trail into the far eastern Alterac Mountains. The path passes the troll ruins of Chillwind Point before descending north through a ravine into the camp.

faq.q: What is the Horde equivalent of this outpost?
faq.answer: The Horde's counterpart is the Bulwark, on the western frontier between Tirisfal Glades and the Western Plaguelands. Both outposts are fortified bases for campaigns against the region's Scourge.

faq.q: Who commands the forces at Chillwind Camp?
aliases: who is in charge of chillwind camp
faq.answer: Commander Ashlam Valorfist leads the garrison at Chillwind Camp. He coordinates Alliance volunteers, Knights of the Silver Hand, and Argent Dawn liaisons in operations across nearby ruins and tainted farms.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can find safe refuge at Chillwind Camp. Griffons provide transit, and commanders issue orders for the effort against the Scourge in northern Lordaeron.

As a promising paladin, you receive direction from Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind to aid Commander Valorfist at Chillwind Camp. There, you bring the Silver Hand's holy wrath against the undead ranks.
